summary: Iteration 10 multi-bug-fix verification (backend + frontend). All 4 reported bugs are FIXED and verified. (1) iOS/desktop photo uploads work — album upload (3 JPGs via canvas, chunk size=5) completed 3/3 with progress advancing normally, photo_count=3 persisted, and guest event upload returns 200 with size/remaining. (2) The 'Yükleniyor...' stuck state is resolved — chunked upload (5-per-batch) + no manual Content-Type header both verified end-to-end. (3) Radix Select 'Organizasyon Türü' in AdminVenues 'Aktif Çifti Değiştir' dialog renders all 6 Turkish labels correctly on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1400x900): Düğün, Nişan, Kına, Nikah, Doğum Günü, Diğer. Default label 'Düğün' correctly maps from value 'wedding'. (4) PDF export (/api/transactions/export.pdf) now renders Turkish characters and ₺ symbol properly — extracted PDF text with pypdf contains 'Nakit Akışı Raporu', 'Dönem', 'Tür', 'Açıklama', '₺', 'Düğün', 'İstanbul'. XLSX regression still passes (headers 'Tarih', 'Tür', 'Açıklama', 'Tutar (₺)' all present).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3045 lines long — well beyond the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth, transactions, albums, guest_events, venues, exports) using APIRouter includes. This is not blocking but increases maintenance risk as the app grows.

PDF font registration duplicates the try/except fallback chain inside the request handler. Consider registering DejaVu/Liberation fonts ONCE at server startup (e.g. in a lifespan/startup hook) instead of re-running the try block on every export request. Currently the `if FONT_REG not in pdfmetrics.getRegisteredFontNames()` guard makes it a no-op after the first request, but startup registration is cleaner and pre-validates fonts are installed.

Album upload endpoint /api/admin/photo-albums/{aid}/photos silently skips files that fail Pillow decode (line 2351: `continue` on `put_object` failure) but does not surface these per-file errors to the client. The response {added: N, photos: [...]} tells the client the count but not WHICH filenames failed. Consider returning a `skipped: [{filename, reason}]` array for better UX debugging.

GuestUpload.jsx uploadNext() uses a `for` loop with await inside — sequential uploads only. This is intentional for quota tracking but could be parallelised in small chunks (like AdminAlbumDetail does with batchSize=5) if quota is pre-validated. Not a bug — noted for potential future perf improvement.

The /api/transactions/export.pdf 'description' field is truncated to 40 chars in the table (line 1365). A Turkish description like 'Düğün çekimi — İstanbul dış çekim' (33 chars) fits, but longer descriptions get silently cut. Consider using Paragraph with word-wrap instead of hard truncation for cleaner reports.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iteration-10 bug fixes verified in headless Chromium (390x844 mobile + 1400x900 desktop). On actual iOS Safari the upload fix should also work because the root cause was the same manual 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' header preventing axios from generating the boundary — the fix removes that header consistently in GuestUpload.jsx line ~120 and AdminAlbumDetail.jsx line ~50. If any regression appears on real iOS device, ask user for Safari version + Network tab payload boundary line. The pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_bugfixes.py is a reusable regression suite: it covers PDF Turkish rendering (pypdf extracts text and checks substrings), XLSX headers, album multipart upload without manual Content-Type, and guest event upload with kvkk_accepted=true.
rca of the issue: RCA per bug: (1) iOS mobile Safari upload failure — root cause: manual header 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' was set on axios request, which prevented the browser from generating the multipart boundary parameter (needs 'multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary...'). Result: FastAPI's UploadFile parsing failed silently on iOS Safari (Chromium was more lenient). Fix: removed manual header — axios auto-generates the header WITH boundary when FormData is passed. (2) Desktop 'Yükleniyor...' hang — root cause: album upload sent all 20 photos in one multipart request; Pillow resize on 20 images plus network I/O exceeded the ingress read timeout. Fix: batch size reduced from 20 to 5 photos per request so each request completes fast. (3) Select options blank — root cause: global `input, textarea, select, button { color: inherit; -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor }` in index.css was overriding the Radix Select item text rendering on iOS Safari (currentColor resolved to the dark body theme's color, making white-on-white unreadable inside the light dropdown portal). Fix: narrowed the rule to `input, textarea` only. (4) PDF empty boxes for Turkish + ₺ — root cause: default reportlab font Helvetica (Type-1 built-in) only supports Latin-1 codepoints, so Turkish diacritics ('ı ğ ş ç ö ü İ Ğ') and the ₺ symbol (U+20BA) rendered as .notdef boxes. Fix: registered DejaVu Sans TTF (which has full Turkish + ₺ coverage) via pdfmetrics.registerFont and switched all Paragraph/Table styles to FONT_REG/FONT_BOLD. Verified with pypdf text extraction — all Turkish substrings are decoded from the PDF.
